items.title: LeRobot v0.7.0: interactive robot prompting, world action models, diskless dataset streaming
items.summary: Hugging Face LeRobot v0.7.0 is live. You can talk to a running robot policy without stopping it, train world action models and new VLAs with FSDP2/HSDP, stream Hub or LanceDB datasets without downloading them first, and run big policies on a remote GPU via lerobot-policy-server. Blog, docs, and GitHub release notes are linked.

reception.summary: Congrats and hardware pointers (SO-101 open arm); thin reply thread so far, no pushback on the release claims.

items.title: Cloudflare open-sources security-audit skill for coding agents
items.summary: Cloudflare released an open-source coding-agent skill that runs a six-phase security audit (recon, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured findings, independent verification, reporting). It is the single-repo seed of Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness and installs via npx skills add.

doubt.pushback: Several users report OpenAI Codex and Anthropic models refuse or hide the skill behind Daybreak/guardrails, so it may only run freely on less restricted models.

reception.summary: Builders praise the structured audit loop and report real findings; many Codex users say the skill is blocked or burns quota until Daybreak access.

items.title: World Labs Frameboy: real-time Atlas world-model explorer at up to 15 fps
items.summary: World Labs released Frameboy, a demo that lets you explore AI-generated worlds in real time with precise camera control, streaming an optimized Atlas world model from cloud GPUs at up to 15 fps. fal notes it powers the demo with serverless inference.

items.title: MiaAI Lab GLM-5.3-Flash recipe update for 2x DGX Sparks (TensorFold)
items.summary: MiaAI Lab shipped recipe 1104 for GLM-5.3-Flash on two DGX Sparks over ConnectX-7 with TensorFold 1.1.9. It reports tool-eval hard-mode 93 with thinking on, 380k-token chats resuming in about 3 seconds instead of 4 minutes, optional WITH_VIDEO=1 image input, and a JSON ID bugfix, with measured tok/s tables in the repo.

items.title: Spark-X2.6-1.7B WebGPU browser demo: ~105 tok/s, 1.21 GB download
items.summary: iFlytek Spark highlights a community WebGPU port of Spark-X2.6-1.7B that runs in a browser tab after a 1.21 GB download. Author tests on an RTX 3090 Ti report about 105 tok/s with thinking off, with a Hugging Face Space demo for Chrome or Edge.

doubt.pushback: SparkLLM says the numbers are the community author's, not a SparkLLM rerun, and other GPUs and phones are untested.

items.title: Linum P-JiT text-to-image model trained for $21K, Apache 2.0 weights
items.summary: Linum AI published a field note and Apache 2.0 release for a 2B Pyramid-JiT text-to-image model trained on 660M samples for about $21K. Code and weights are on GitHub and Hugging Face as an experimental step toward cheaper video models.
